title: Underground Wonders: 10 Places Around the World Where You Can Walk Through Ancient Salt Mines
description: Salt mines around the world offer a fascinating look into the ancient techniques that shaped commerce and regional societies. Visitors can wander through elaborate underground tunnels and vast chambers, which tell the stories of historical mining practices. Today, many of these notable sites are enhanced with contemporary attractions and educational programs.

description: “El Marsam: Modern and Contemporary Art From Egypt,” at the Middle East Institute, highlights Egypt’s legacy as a center of modernism in the Middle East, with works by 29 artists.

title: Australia returns ancient stone heads to China after more than 30 years
description: The Song dynasty sculptures were given to the National Gallery of Australia in the 1990s, a time when art theft was rife in China

title: Ancient Rock Paintings in India: 10 Remarkable Places Where Prehistoric Art Can Still Be Seen
description: India is home to a wealth of ancient rock art sites, offering a glimpse into the lives and artistic endeavors of early societies. Marvel at places like the Bhimbetka Rock Shelters, Jogimara Caves, and Ajanta Caves, where vivid paintings and engravings reveal the day-to-day activities and wildlife interactions of prehistoric inhabitants. Visiting these historic locations is a profound way to engage with the richness of India's cultural legacy.
